verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail supports some bulk actions like depositing multiple checks together and general 'automation rules' for mail handling, plus an API/Zapier integration for building custom workflows. However, there's no documented bulk API endpoint, batch-processing capability, or evidence of bulk operations across mail items (e.g., mass scan/shred/forward requests) — missing for 10: explicit bulk API endpoints, documented batch mail actions, and any AI-native tooling (OpenAPI spec returns 404s) confirming programmatic bulk operations.
